(()=>{const rows=[...document.querySelectorAll('#gc-device table.mx tbody tr')];const txt=(r)=>r.innerText.replace(/\s+/g,' ').replace(/\u200b/g,'');const need=['NOTI_INT_CHANNEL_MESSAGE','NOTI_PARTNER_ITEM_CANCELED','NOTI_BULK_DELAY_NOTICE','NOTI_PARTNER_BULK_DELAY_NOTICE','NOTI_BIZ_STATUS_RESTORED','NOTI_RETURN_BACK_DUE','NOTI_PARTNER_RETURN_BACK'];const miss=need.filter(c=>!rows.some(r=>txt(r).includes(c)));const bare=rows.filter(r=>{const s=[...r.querySelectorAll('td.sym')];return [3,5].some(i=>s[i]&&s[i].textContent==='○'&&!s[i].title)}).map(txt);const cell=(code,i)=>{const r=rows.find(x=>txt(x).includes(code+' ')||txt(x).endsWith(code));const s=r?[...r.querySelectorAll('td.sym')][i]:null;return s?s.textContent+(s.title?':'+s.title:''):'?'};const chk={orderNewMail:cell('NOTI_PARTNER_ORDER_NEW',3),handedMail:cell('NOTI_PARTNER_PACKAGE_HANDED_OFF',3),scanMail:cell('NOTI_FILE_SCAN_REJECTED',3),chSlack:cell('NOTI_INT_CHANNEL_MESSAGE',5),backPush:cell('NOTI_RETURN_BACK_DUE',2)};const legend=document.querySelector('#gc-device').innerText.includes('이메일·내부 Slack 칸에는 조건 없는 ○를 쓰지 않아요');if(miss.length||bare.length||chk.orderNewMail!=='●'||chk.handedMail!=='●'||chk.scanMail!=='○:○ 화면을 떠났을 때'||!chk.chSlack.startsWith('○:○ 10분')||chk.backPush!=='○'||!legend)throw new Error('매트릭스 '+JSON.stringify({miss,bare,chk,legend}));return chk})()
